document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: A diagram of eight stages in a snake layout. Stage 1: used bottles are collected. Stage 2: they are transported to a recycling plant. Stage 3: they are sorted by colour. Stage 4: they are washed. Stage 5: they are shredded into small flakes. Stage 6: the flakes are melted. Stage 7: the melted plastic is made into pellets. Stage 8: the pellets are used to make new products.
